description: Defines classes and structs for managing and retrieving cgroup memory and processor information in a Linux environment, including CGroupMemoryInfo, CGroupProcessorInfo, and CGroupMetrics.

classes.name: CGroupMemoryInfo
classes.description: Holds memory usage details such as allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: CGroupProcessorInfo
classes.description: Provides CPU core usage statistics and total CPU usage.

classes.name: CGroupMetrics
classes.description: Helper class to collect and provide cgroup memory and CPU metrics.

methods.name: Memory
methods.description: Retrieves memory usage information from cgroup files.

methods.name: ProcessorInfo
methods.description: Retrieves CPU core usage information from cgroup files.
